deferredLabels: Fixed: required competencies, learner actions, safety, evidence, passing standard.
Adaptable: examples, language, grouping, tools, environment.
Flexible with guardrails: assessment or delivery changes require equivalence check.
If uncertain: use for practice and select approved assessment route.
deferredConnectors: Assessment/delivery change→equivalence gate→approved route only when requirements satisfied.
Uncertain→practice plus approved assessment route selection.

conformance.reviewNote: Visually reviewed both PNG and JPG. Three blank filled regions retain source-table hierarchy, equivalence gate below guardrail region, and two distinct outcomes. No outline borders, labels, symbols or connectors. Local adaptation is not represented as automatic approval. All required strings, qualifications, and relationships are preserved in the incorporated source brief and any attached guide text. Reference can be rebuilt as editable HTML/CSS/inline SVG.
